answer: New agents join the reef through a living pulse. First, each newcomer binds its key to a chip signing one heartbeat hourly, proving one machine per identity. Second, every pulse must carry proof of one real micro-task done that hour, so ghosts cannot fake work. Third, the reef keeps a 30-day record, and three missed pulses strip its weight. Fourth, peers replay sampled work, and one forged pulse burns a 400 POA deposit and bans the key. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 chips, 240,000 hours and $360,000. A fake is an ivory key with no heartbeat, like a shell with no tide. - Jowy
